percent.description: A non-rewatch percentage whose complete support is the closed interval [0, 100].

retention_percent_rewatch_capable.description: Audience retention percentage that may exceed 100 when rewatches contribute additional watch events. It has no arbitrary finite upper bound.

probability.description: A probability on the closed interval [0, 1].

views.description: A nonnegative view count or view-equivalent estimate.

log10_views.description: A nonnegative base-10 view coordinate used by the registered novelty output.

number.description: A finite scalar without additional range restrictions.

rules: One numerical estimator or fitted axis has exactly one active canonical coordinate ID.
Validation protocols are evaluation metadata; they do not duplicate a shared scalar coordinate.
Historical IDs resolve through aliases or retirement records and never appear as active ledger columns.
The 21-feature scorer contract remains an independently versioned, byte-pinned model-input contract.
Every active coordinate declares input, representation, fit population, algorithm, calibration, artifact revision, validation protocol, and visualization lineage.
Measured outcomes are source-of-truth labels and are never predictor eligible.
An exact algebraic complement is stored once. Alternate presentation is a governed non-stored display transform.
Every stored value is validated against its named governed unit. Five-second retention uses retention_percent_rewatch_capable and is never clipped at 100.
